name: Supertex Industries Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1986, Supertex Industries Ltd does Texturizing, Twisting, Draw Warping, and Sizing of Polyester Filament Yarn.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
SIL is engaged in the manufacture of draw-warp and sized yarn beams of polyester and nylon. It also manufactures textured and twisted yarns of polyester and nylon. It exports these yarns and trades in textile fabrics.
